ModMetaData.name: Hay Waste Mod
ModMetaData.author: URAS
ModMetaData.description:
Implements harvest byproducts system. According to harvest yield efficiency, crops will generate Hay (biomass) as a secondary output using inverse ratio calculation.
Cosecha Fallida (0% yield): 10 unidades de Hay Cosecha Perfecta (100% yield): 1 unidad de Hay
Fórmula: CantidadHeno = Clamp(11 - UnidadesCosechadas, 1, 10)
Compatible with RimWorld 1.4, 1.5, and 1.6
